purpose: Freeze the non-arbitrary angular, orientation, gauge-patch, charge-lattice, frame and parameter-role conventions of the two-disk C-PHYS boundary-value problem while leaving the exact bulk and cap functions open for a separate source-explicit model-selection decision.

angular_convention.reason: The angular reparametrization chi_new=c chi leaves X_sigma, F_rchi/L, Q and Phi_F invariant, so Delta_chi=2*pi fixes coordinate redundancy rather than physical data.

regional_coordinates_and_orientations.r_N: increases from the north smooth pole to the common cap
regional_coordinates_and_orientations.r_S: increases from the south smooth pole to the common cap
regional_coordinates_and_orientations.distinction: Boundary-normal signs control local junction variations; epsilon signs control integration of the globally oriented two-form when both regional coordinates point from a pole toward the cap.

global_flux_contract.equivalence: With the frozen regular pole gauges and transition function, R_flux and R_patch are the same global topological condition and must be counted once.
global_flux_contract.superseded_orientation_sensitive_formula: An unoriented plain sum over regional integrals is not valid when both local radial coordinates increase from their poles to the cap.

q_ref.role: minimal positive bulk U(1) charge unit

charge_lattice.reason: For Delta_chi=2*pi, all charged fields must transform single-valuedly under the U(1) transition function; the cap phase charge therefore lies on the q_ref lattice.

four_dimensional_frame.interpretation: This removes the additive warp redundancy by normalizing the four-dimensional metric at the north pole.

not_additional_independent_residuals.R_flux: equivalent to R_patch under the frozen regular gauges and global orientation
not_additional_independent_residuals.rr_constraints: propagated QA channels after dependency proof, not endpoint conditions
not_additional_independent_residuals.phase_equation: automatic for the static homogeneous winding ansatz

admissible_function_class.U: C2 on the declared scalar domain, dimension M^6, bounded below on that domain
admissible_function_class.Z_F: C2 and strictly positive on the declared scalar domain, dimensionless
admissible_function_class.lambda: C2 on the declared scalar domain, dimension M^5
admissible_function_class.Z_sigma: C2 and strictly positive on the active winding branch, dimension M^3

closed_items: U(1) transition function and patch residual
oriented flux formula and patch-flux equivalence
open_items: numerical q_ref value or normalization scale
principal symbol and complementing boundary-condition audit
forbidden_inferences: No C1-V numerical parameter or functional-form migration.
No numerical equality q_sigma=q_ref unless m_sigma=1 is separately selected.
No double counting of patch and global flux residuals.
No physical BVP execution before exact function and scalar-domain selection.
No Fredholm, existence, stability, K1-D or K1-E claim.
